description: What a delivered row is, beyond the workbook's own 레코드구분. A rule names the element, the role its matching rows play, the reader-facing label for that role, the conditions read from the row's own columns, and the source basis. Cards (scripts/v140/card-model-v140.mjs), the detail summary and list (PublicPortfolioSummaryV132 / PublicPortfolioListV132) and the analysis QA read this same file.

roles.individual: one record of the register (a project, a guarantee, a company)
roles.aggregate: a total or explanatory line the source marks 레코드구분=집계
roles.definition: a description of a category the register uses (a product, a type), not a record

rules.label: 보증 유형 안내
rules.basis: MIGA project DB export (D-026.xlsx, 1.2 레코드형): 14 rows marked 레코드구분=개별. Nine carry a numeric MIGA Project_ID, a guarantee holder, an amount, a fiscal year and a guarantee type. Five (Breach of Contract, Non-Honoring of Sovereign Financial Obligations, Expropriation, Transfer Restriction / Currency Inconvertibility, War and Civil Disturbance) describe MIGA's four political-risk covers and the NHSFO product: their 국가 column reads '4대 PRI' or '신용보강', their 섹터 column holds the product description, and they state no amount, holder, fiscal year or guarantee type. They explain the 보증_유형 values of the nine projects and stay on the screen as that explanation.
